accepted_precision.method: stratified estimate weighted by distinct resolutions per tier; interval propagated from per-tier Wilson bounds, not a normal approximation
accepted_precision.caveat: the sample is drawn by a disproportionate per-tier quota, so this reweighting is required; it is also what makes the figure higher than the raw rows, so read it next to raw_sample_precision below

raw_sample_precision.note: the unweighted result over the rows a human actually read. 38 of the 58 rows in this sample sit in an accepting tier; the rest are refusals and are scored separately. The sample size is 58, the precision denominator is 38 -- these are different numbers and quoting the first as the second overstates the evidence

withheld_tier_quality.reading: most proposals held for review are wrong, which is the evidence that the automatic threshold is not set too low

limitations: labels assigned by one reviewer (the pipeline author); no second annotator

FUZZY_AUTO, SALT_STRIPPED and CLEANED have so few distinct values that the development sample consumed all of them; their rates are carried over and are therefore optimistic, since the rules were tuned on exactly those rows
reference vocabulary is scoped to NSCLC drug candidates, so a correct refusal to resolve an out-of-scope drug counts as missing coverage, not as an error
sampling is stratified by tier, so tier-level rates are far more precise than the rare tiers' raw counts suggest, but tiers with very few distinct values still carry wide intervals
